name: lattice-loader
title: Lattice Loader
description: Compact status rows for background tasks: a grid of cells pulses in patterns beside a label and a running stopwatch, then switches to a green done mark when the row finishes.
use: An AI agent or background job needs a compact, readable status line with a timer.
avoid: The dots are tiny and low-contrast at default size, so the animation is easy to miss from a distance.
a11y: A status role announces the label, but the ticking timer is aria-hidden so intermediate seconds are never spoken. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Three stacked rows on a dark card, each led by a small square grid of round dots, followed by a bright label and a smaller grey timer. The finished row's dots turn green and its timer stays fixed while the others count up.
behaves: The dots light in a travelling pattern while the timer beside them counts every tenth of a second. On completion the lattice fades out, green dots snap into a check-like mark and the timer freezes.
customise: Label, done and error text, status, pattern (named or a custom cell map), grid size, shape, colours, cell size, gap, font size, step, idle opacity, glow, timer and elapsed are props.
weight: light: A few dozen spans with CSS opacity loops and a hundred-millisecond timer; negligible.
